python3 -c "
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('tests/codegen/undefined_variables.rs')
t = p.read_text()
old = '''/// MEASURED on \`php -n\` 8.5.6: \`false && \$x = 1; echo \$x;\` warns on LINE 2 — the read — because
/// the short-circuit means the assignment never ran. A merge that treated the assignment as
/// definite would print nothing and swallow the warning.'''
new = '''/// MEASURED on \`php -n\` 8.5.6: the warning names the ECHO's line, not the assignment's, because
/// the short-circuit means the assignment never ran and the variable is undefined at the read. A
/// merge that treated the branch assignment as definite would print nothing and swallow it.'''
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new))
print('doc corrected')
": doc corrected
